# Ravensbourne Freight - rate card

Effective 1 June 2026 until further notice. This edition replaces every earlier
rate card.

Charges are billed per consignment as chargeable weight multiplied by the rate
for the destination zone.

| destination zone | rate per chargeable kg |
| --- | --- |
| Zone 1 | 3.20 |
| Zone 2 | 4.75 |

Rate queries: rates@ravensbourne-freight.example

files.README.md:
# Kestrel Preserves - Bellhaven depot despatch log

One row per consignment collected at Bellhaven in September 2026.
chargeable_kg is the weight Ravensbourne Freight bills on.

Ravensbourne bills each consignment as chargeable_kg multiplied by the
per-kilogram rate for its destination zone in the carrier's published rate card.
